name: FightPreview_IsPartTypeFlagSet
comment: leitor da mascara de protecao bot+0xCF (bits 01/08/02/04 por tipo 0D/0F/11/13). Chamadores de combate: AV, BE, I_00 (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AV_ApplyStatusToOpponents
comment: AV 0x03: bloqueia status novo pela mascara bot+0xCF do alvo (0D/10/12/13); 0x2C sem mascara (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AV_0D_ApplyBugVirusUnlessMasked
comment: handler AV tipo 0x0D: se mascara 0x01 livre, fi+0xD2+k=1 e SetPending(alvo,0x0D) (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AV_10_ApplyFreezeUnlessMasked
comment: handler AV tipo 0x10: mascara 0x08 (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AV_12_ApplyHoldUnlessMasked
comment: handler AV tipo 0x12: mascara 0x02 (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AV_13_ApplyFireUnlessMasked
comment: handler AV tipo 0x13: mascara 0x04 (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AV_2C_ApplyConfusion
comment: handler AV tipo 0x2C (Confusion): aplica sem teste de mascara (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_BE_RollRandomStatus
comment: BE: rand&7 em fi+0xD6+2k (0->0D 1->11 2->13 3->10); mascara do alvo bloqueia (grava 5) (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_I_07_ApplyPartStateEffectAtXY
comment: unica rota de tecnica arbitraria: SetPending(fi+0x88, tecnica da peca k, fi+0xE8, fi+0xEC); rota de 0x2E/0x2F (C, SS2)

name: Fight_ApplyPendingEffectStatusFlags
comment: alvo bot+0xBC |= 04 se pendente 2E, |= 08 se 2F, |= 0C se 0F/10; ator 1->4 2->8 (C, SS2). Sem xref no Ghidra

name: Fight_ApplyEvasionReductionToRos
comment: esquiva: pula o calculo se defensor bot+0xBC & 04 (bypass 2E); liga +0xBC 0x10 quando esquiva (C, SS2)

name: Fight_ApplyDefenseReductionToRos
comment: defesa: pula a reducao se defensor bot+0xBC & 08 (bypass 2F); liga +0xBC 0x20 quando defende (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_W_07_ApplyActorChargeBuff
comment: ator: bot+0xBD |= 08, +0xDF = tecnica da peca (C, HN1); ligacao com Boost/Rapid/Accel = P (SS2)

name: Fight_FindAllyFollowupActionSource
comment: E00: grava fi+0xDE (1-based do aliado) e fi+0xDF (tipo) a partir de bot+0xBD&8 (C, SS2)

name: Fight_UpdatePhaseFromCounter
comment: fi+0x87 = fi+0x45-1; fi+0x89 = (fi+0x45-1)/3 (indice de fase/suporte); fi+0x8A = fi+0x89^1 (C, SS2). Nome mtbe confirmado

name: Fight_DrawPartStatusIcon
comment: icone de peca: bot+0xBD 0x10 = modo estatico; 0x08 = modo por tipo +0xDF; exige armadura de bot+0xDE-1 (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AM_0A_ClearSlotSetPartDisplayValue
comment: liga bot ativo +0xBD |= 0x10 (modo estatico do icone), +0xDF = tecnica da peca (C, HA8)

name: ActionFamily_TrapFamily_Handler
comment: armadilhas 10/11: estado nao lido nesta rodada (A, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_Z_0F_SetStepCode1C
comment: Scout: grava so fi+0xA6=0x1C (mensagem); bonus de acerto e via registro fi+0x28 (C, SS2)

name: Fight_DispatchOnSubstateAA_AA_0B_SetStepCode1D
comment: Conceal: grava so fi+0xA6=0x1D (mensagem) (C, SS2)

name: fight_information
comment: struct de luta (SS2 usa fi+0x28 registro de suporte 8B, fi+0x87 ator, fi+0x88 alvo, fi+0x89 fase, fi+0xA6 mensagem, fi+0xD2 +k flag de aplicacao, fi+0xD6 halfword de rolagem por slot, fi+0xDE/0xDF aliado de followup, fi+0xE8/0xEC p3/p4 de SetPending)

name: fight_support_record_0x28
comment: registro de suporte de 8 B (Scout), indexado por fi+0x89 (DM.md); escritor nao achado (A, SS2)

name: fight_slot_applied_flags
comment: fi+0xD2+k = 1 quando o status foi aplicado ao slot k (C, SS2)

name: fight_slot_roll_halfword
comment: halfword por slot k (fi+0xD6+2k); valor 5 = bloqueado pela mascara (BE) (C, SS2)

name: fight_followup_part_1based
comment: fi+0xDE = indice 1-based do aliado de followup (E00) (C, SS2); diferente de bot+0xDE

name: fight_followup_type
comment: fi+0xDF = tipo do aliado de followup (C, SS2)

name: battle_bot0_flags_BC
comment: bot+0xBC: bits 01/02 (ator), 04 (bypass esquiva), 08 (bypass defesa), 10 (esquivou), 20 (defendeu), 40 (critico) (C, SS2)

name: battle_bot0_flags_BD
comment: bot+0xBD: 08 = carga (W_07, E00, icone modo A); 10 = icone modo B (AM_0A) (C, SS2)

name: battle_bot0_affinity_BF
comment: bot+0xBF: codigo de afinidade do ataque (2 optico, 3 bomba, 4 gravidade) (P, R2.md; nao reconfirmado)

name: battle_bot0_status_C9
comment: bot+0xC9 tipo do status pendente = id de tecnica (C, SS2 secao 0)

name: battle_bot0_protect_mask_CF
comment: bot+0xCF mascara de protecao: 01 Bug/Virus, 08 Freeze, 02 Hold, 04 Fire (C, SS2 secao 1)

name: battle_bot0_chosen_part_DD
comment: bot+0xDD peca escolhida 1..3 (DF.md, Fight_SelectActionSource) (C, SS2)

name: battle_bot0_part_icon_DE
comment: bot+0xDE indice 1-based da peca do icone de status; escritor nao achado (A, SS2)

name: battle_bot0_part_icon_type_DF
comment: bot+0xDF tipo de acao/tecnica do icone de peca (C, SS2)
